Loft Insulation Installation and Upgrades

We take out old or damaged loft insulation, vacuum the loft floor and lay new Knauf or Rockwool insulation to 300mm. Most lofts take us 1 to 2 days, and quotes are free after an assessment.

How We Insulate a Loft

We usually fit 100mm between the joists and 200mm cross-laid over them to reach 300mm. Before any of that goes down we assess the loft, take out the old insulation where it needs to come out, and vacuum and clean the loft floor.

We Check More Than the Insulation

While we're up there we look at the ventilation, any moisture, protection for downlights and the loft access. All of it is done by our own directly employed team, to the Building Regulations that apply.

What Others Get Wrong

We often find new insulation laid straight over old material with no preparation or cleaning. Blocked ventilation, missed areas and squashed insulation are common too. We assess the loft first, clear out anything unsuitable and vacuum the floor before the new insulation goes in.

When Loft Insulation Is Worth Doing

  • There isn't enough insulation in the loft, or none at all
  • The insulation is old, flattened or damaged
  • You want to cut the heat escaping through the roof

How Long It Takes

Usually done in 1 to 2 days. Free quotes after an assessment.
